about_short_description.short_description: AI-powered auditing platform that delivers insights and actions to CPG brands and retailers via data from shelf cameras, robots, and humans.

product.name: Shelf Audit
product.description: A service where field representatives visit stores to capture photos and data on product availability, pricing, facings, and shelf conditions to identify out-of-stocks and execution issues.

product.name: Category Intelligence
product.description: A platform that uses AI and data to map product categories, monitor competitor performance, and analyze sales drivers by combining shelf and sales data.

product.name: ROI-Led Merchandising
product.description: A fully managed merchandising program that optimizes store visits and merchandising efforts based on sales data to maximize return on investment at the store and SKU level.

product.name: Site Survey
product.description: A service that collects detailed photos and measurements of store fixtures and layouts to ensure proper signage placement and display installation across retail locations.
